"""RoboLab white mug centering controller. Uses only calibrated camera frames and proprioception."""
import os, json, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image

OUT='/app/output'
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
r=Robot()

def obs_save(tag='obs'):
    o=r.get_obs(depth=True,video='none')
    for cam,img in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(img).save(f'{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}.png')
    for cam,d in o.last_depth.items(): np.save(f'{OUT}/{tag}_{cam}_depth.npy',d)
    return o

def pixel_world(cam, u, v, z=None, obs=None):
    """Map pixel and depth z (camera z-depth) to env-local point."""
    s=r.spec(); c=s['cameras'][cam]
    K=np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'],float)
    if obs is None: obs=r.get_obs(depth=True,video='none')
    if z is None: z=float(obs.last_depth[cam][int(round(v)),int(round(u))])
    E=np.asarray(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['extrinsic_cv'],float)
    pcam=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z])
    return E[:,:3].T@(pcam-E[:,3])

if __name__=='__main__':
    o=obs_save('init')
    cam='over_shoulder_left_camera'
    pts={'cornerA':(410,376),'cornerB':(729,278),'cornerC':(992,389),'cornerD':(761,520),
         'center_wood':(702,400),'mug_body':(860,438),'mug_handle':(900,438),'mug_bbox_center':(872,438)}
    for name,(u,v) in pts.items():
        d=o.last_depth[cam][v,u]
        print(name,(u,v),'depth',float(d),'world',pixel_world(cam,u,v,float(d),o).round(4).tolist())
    print('proprio',o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print('status',r.status())
